metadata.question: Does the surface soil moisture in Utah decrease in August 2020, compare to long-term records for the same month?

data.raw_code: 1. Question: Soil moisture in Utah, August 2020 vs long-term records for August 2. Need soil moisture data - SMAP (Soil Moisture Active Passive) is ideal for this 3. Time periods: August 2020 vs long-term August records (say 2015-2019) 4. Location: Utah state boundary 5. Need to handle potential missing data issues 6. SMAP data: SMAP/Sentinel-1 L2 Radiometer/Radar 30-Second Scene 3 km Strategy: - Get Utah geometry - Get SMAP data for August 2020 and August 2015-2019 (long-term) - Calculate mean soil moisture for each period - Compare if 2020 < long-term average Potential issues: - SMAP data might have gaps - Need to check collection sizes - Need to check valid pixel counts - Need reasonable validation (soil moisture should be between 0-1 m³/m³ typically) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const utah = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Utah')); const aug2020 = ee.DateRange('2020-08-01', '2020-08-31'); const augLongTerm = ee.DateRange('2015-08-01', '2019-08-31'); // 2. Data Acquisition const smap2020 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E/005') .filterBounds(utah) .filterDate(aug2020) .select('soil_moisture_am'); const smapLongTerm = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E/005') .filterBounds(utah) .filterDate(augLongTerm) .select('soil_moisture_am'); // Check collection sizes const count2020 = smap2020.size().getInfo(); const countLongTerm = smapLongTerm.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 August Images: ${count2020}`); console.log(`Long-term August Images: ${countLongTerm}`); if (count2020 === 0 || countLongTerm === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create mean composites const mean2020 = smap2020.mean(); const meanLongTerm = smapLongTerm.mean(); // Check valid pixels const count2020Pixels = mean2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: utah, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('soil_moisture_am').getInfo(); const countLongTermPixels = meanLongTerm.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: utah, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('soil_moisture_am').getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Valid Pixels: ${count2020Pixels}`); console.log(`Long-term Valid Pixels: ${countLongTermPixels}`); if (count2020Pixels === 0 || countLongTermPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation const sm2020 = mean2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: utah, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('soil_moisture_am').getInfo(); const smLongTerm = meanLongTerm.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: utah, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('soil_moisture_am').getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Soil Moisture: ${sm2020 ? sm2020.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); console.log(`Long-term Soil Moisture: ${smLongTerm ? smLongTerm.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (sm2020 === null || smLongTerm === null || isNaN(sm2020) || isNaN(smLongTerm) || sm2020 < 0 || sm2020 > 1 || smLongTerm < 0 || smLongTerm > 1) { console.log("C3"); } else if (sm2020 < smLongTerm) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
